premise: A little cloud slides over the moon and away again, and Raccoon is sure the moon is playing peekaboo with him; he plays back, Firefly joins in with her light, Hedgehog falls asleep laughing, and Raccoon nods off mid-game.
inspiration: The folk moon-that-follows-you motif, turned into a game of peekaboo that ends in sleep.
lesson: The whole world can be a playmate.

en-US.title: Raccoon Plays Peekaboo with the Moon
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8 20s} {sfx:crickets} [softly] The moon was up, round and bright, and {raccoon:enter} Raccoon was wide awake. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} Hello, moon! {canvas:clouds 0.6 9s} Then a little cloud drifted over it. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] The moon was gone! {raccoon:wobble} Where did it go? The cloud drifted by… and there it was again. Peekaboo! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] The moon was playing peekaboo! So Raccoon played back. {raccoon:live hold} He hid his eyes behind his paws. Where's Raccoon? {raccoon:live resume} BOO! {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came snuffling up to see. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:wobble x2} [laughs] He laughed and laughed. Then {firefly:enter} Firefly came drifting down to play too. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Her light went bright… then dim. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink! Peekaboo! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Everyone giggled. Then Hedgehog gave a yawn. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live hold} He curled up into a ball, still smiling. [whispers] One more, said Raccoon. {raccoon:face sleeping} {raccoon:live hold} He hid his eyes… and this time he didn't peek out. He was fast asleep. And the moon? [softly] It played peekaboo with them all night long.

es-ES.title: Cucú-tras con la luna
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8 20s} {sfx:crickets} [softly] La luna había salido, redonda y brillante, y {raccoon:enter} Mapache estaba despiertísimo. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} ¡Hola, luna! {canvas:clouds 0.6 9s} Entonces una nubecita pasó por delante. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] ¡La luna había desaparecido! {raccoon:wobble} ¿Dónde se ha metido? La nubecita siguió su camino… y allí estaba otra vez. ¡Cucú! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] ¡La luna estaba jugando al cucú-tras! Así que Mapache jugó también. {raccoon:live hold} Se tapó los ojos con las patas. ¿Dónde está Mapache? {raccoon:live resume} ¡TRAS! {hedgehog:enter} Erizo llegó olisqueando a ver qué pasaba. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:wobble x2} [laughs] Y se rió y se rió. Luego {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga bajó volando a jugar. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Su luz se encendió… y se apagó. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} ¡Blin, blin! ¡Cucú! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Todos se rieron. Entonces Erizo bostezó. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live hold} Se hizo una bola, todavía sonriendo. [whispers] Otra vez, dijo Mapache. {raccoon:face sleeping} {raccoon:live hold} Se tapó los ojos… y esta vez no volvió a asomarse. Se había quedado dormido. ¿Y la luna? [softly] Estuvo jugando al cucú con ellos toda la noche.

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

twinkle.prompt: two tiny soft twinkles, like a little light blinking on and off, playful
